scientific_integrity: An analytic cubic-discriminant proof supports the classification; numerical checks are auxiliary. Full-text comparisons do not exhaust mixture-distribution literature.
scientific_limitations: Equal positive impulses; zero initial storage; four identical linear reservoirs; exact cutoff is not asserted for unequal amplitudes, other reservoir depths, or nonlinear catchments. Nash original publication year 1957 is known, but original calendar date was not verified; 2014-12-09 is the precisely dated public archive record, not an origin date. External mathematical or hydrological originality validation not performed.
title: A sharp two-storm resolution threshold in the four-reservoir Nash hydrograph
